title: Impact of replacement per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances on an indirect potable water reuse scheme
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,2698-2711
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00737B, Paper
Maria José Farré, Maria Rosa Boleda, Guillem Carrera, Marta Ganzer, Meritxell Minoves, Adrià Rubirola, Aniol Roca, Miquel Paraira
Field-scale assessment of replacement PFAS in operational indirect potable reuse, revealing 6 : 2 FTS as predominant compound and demonstrating effective removal through advanced treatment technologies.
